_README: Hand-curated BEC (battery eliminator circuit) data per board.
Source-of-truth: vendor datasheets / ArduPilot wiki. Not parseable from hwdef.
Keys are board slugs (must match hwdef directory names).
Each entry is a list of rails. Fields:
rail       — short label shown in UI (e.g. 'Servo', 'Peripheral', 'VTX')
current_a  — max continuous current in amps (number)
